title: Login page: the inputs are named by their labels, the dev-admin button by its visible text, and the language button has a name
body:
## Source

Read from the accessibility tree on objectui main `efa9cb4fa`, `/login` after objectui#12600 landed:

- `textbox "name@example.com"` and `textbox "Enter your password"`: the inputs are named by their placeholders; the visible labels "Email" and "Password" are not associated (`for`/`id` or `aria-labelledby`), so a screen reader hears the placeholder and loses it once the field is filled.
- `button "admin@objectos.ai"`: the "Sign in as dev admin" button's accessible name is the email (an `aria-label` or `title` that differs from the visible text), which breaks label-in-name for voice control ("click Sign in as dev admin" does nothing).
- `button` with no name: the language (globe) button in the footer.
- The "Show password" button is named; the links are named.

## Target

1. `<label for>` on both inputs; the placeholder stays as a hint; the error text is linked with `aria-describedby`.
2. The dev-admin button's accessible name starts with its visible text ("Sign in as dev admin, admin@objectos.ai" is fine; "admin@objectos.ai" alone is not).
3. The language button has `aria-label` "Language" and the current locale as its tooltip.

## File surface

`apps/console/src/pages/auth/LoginPage.tsx`, `AuthLayout.tsx`, `packages/auth/src/` form fields, tests beside.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: `getByLabelText('Email')`, `getByLabelText('Password')`, `getByRole('button', { name: /^Sign in as dev admin/ })`, `getByRole('button', { name: 'Language' })` resolve.
2. The accessibility tree of `/login` pasted in the PR.
3. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console test` green (or the package that holds the page).

## Evidence

Screenshots on the temporary branch `claude/console-home-login-design-20261016` of objectstack-ai/objectui (commit `0f4e3f4ee`, never merged): [r4-login-page.jpg](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/0f4e3f4ee/docs/design/review-r4-2026-10-16/r4-login-page.jpg?raw=true).

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-16 fourth review: objectui main `efa9cb4fa`, HotCRM `4f82b815` on platform 18.0.0-next.2, the vite console on :5180 against `objectstack dev` on :4001, the maintainer's browser pane at 1024 × 768 (dark, en). The maintainer asked for every finding to be filed on the repository it belongs to, verbatim: 「全部立卡，平台问题到 objectui，审计日志核查到 objectstack，HotCRM 转化流程到 hotcrm。」</sub>
